memory_candidates.content: When a consumer scrapes another script's verdict lines with an unanchored `grep -F '[TOKEN]'`, the natural hardening fix (anchor to line start: `grep -E '^\[TOKEN\] '`) is actively dangerous if any producer emits colored output. In this repository 12 of 14 verdict-line producers use `echo -e "${RED}[FAIL]${NC} $1"` with no TTY or NO_COLOR guard, so their lines begin with an ANSI SGR escape, not the literal token. A uniform line-start anchor converts those producers' gates into silent zero-finding gates while looking like a correctness improvement. The correct shape is two-step: strip SGR sequences (`\x1b\[[0-9;]*m`) first, then anchor. Any such anchoring change must prove per-site finding-set equivalence against a pre-change capture WITH a seeded violation per site, because a zero-finding regression is indistinguishable from a clean pass.
